jobs.occupation: Head of Consolidation und Closing (all genders) (Chief Operating Officer)
jobs.description: Unternehmenthyssenkrupp Automotive Technology is on its way to becoming an independent, capital-market-ready group, and the responsibility for consolidation will move into Automotive Technology. Worldwide, thyssenkrupp Bilstein stands for innovation and high technology in suspension engineering. With expertise in complete suspension systems and production facilities in Europe, the Americas, and China, the company supplies products covering the full spectrum of damping applications. Consolidation und Closing function – including know-how transfer and the set-up of roles, processes and interfaces.- You own the closing process end to end and make it work reliably: closing calendar design und execution, validation of reporting packages, quality gates and status tracking – steering the close across legal entities and the Finance Operations team through to the consolidated figures.- You are responsible for the IFRS consolidation – capital, debt, income and expense consolidation, intercompany and interim profit eliminations – and for the consolidated statements, including cash flow statement, statement of changes in equity and the IFRS 8 segment reconciliation.- You assess and account for complex changes in the group structure – initial consolidations, deconsolidations, changes in shareholdings, non-controlling interests, disposals and discontinued operations (IFRS 3, 5, 10) – and support potential MundA and portfolio transactions.- You are responsible for tax accounting at group level – deferred taxes and the group tax reconciliation – in close cooperation with the Tax department.- You manage the audit of the consolidated financial statements – audit plan and timetable, PBC coordination and management letter follow-up – and are in regular contact with the auditor on operational accounting and closing topics.- You are the functional owner of the consolidation and closing logic in our systems and actively shape the implementation of our new planning, consolidation and reporting tool.- You make the close faster, more robust and capital-market-ready through fast close, standardisation, automation and data quality – and you are the go-to contact for complex consolidation questions across the group.Profil- You hold a degree in business administration or economics with a focus on accounting, audit or finance; a professional qualification (e.g. WP, CPA, ACCA) is a plus.- You have several years of experience in group consolidation of complex international structures – in the group accounting function of a listed or capital-market-oriented company and/or at an audit firm.- You have in-depth IFRS expertise, particularly in consolidation (IFRS 3, 5, 10, 11, IAS 12, IAS 21); experience with IFRS 9 hedge accounting and IFRS 16 is an advantage. You discuss accounting positions with auditors on an equal footing.- You have first leadership experience – disciplinary or as a functional or project lead – and want to build, develop and grow a high-performing team.- You have hands-on experience with consolidation and ERP systems, an affinity for data and automation, and ideally a track record in system implementation or fast-close projects.- Experience with carve-outs, spin-offs, IPOs or capital market readiness projects is a strong plus.- You communicate fluently in German and English. You work in a structured, hands-on way, stay calm under deadline pressure, take ownership and build trust across functions and countries.Das bieten wirA spirit of teamwork and mutual respect has been part of our culture for over 200 years. If these values are as important to you as they are to us, apply now!Wir wertschätzen VielfaltWe value diversity and welcome all applications, regardless of gender, nationality, ethnic or social background, religion or beliefs, disability, age, sexual orientation, or identity.

jobs.description: AnstellungsdetailsPermanent Contract, Full-or Part-Time, Remote or Cologne / Düsseldorf / Darmstadt / BerlinInfoWho we areWe operate the international online marketplaces of Kaufland: Several thousand sellers and millions of products make us one of the fastest growing online marketplaces. Ours is a dynamic corporate culture that merges a start-up mentality with the opportunities offered by a large corporation. We combine knowledge and many years of experience in e-commerce with flat hierarchies and a highly motivated team.We love flexibility! You have the freedom to choose whether you want to work remotely (within Germany) or at one of our offices in Cologne, Darmstadt, Düsseldorf, or in our co-working space in Berlin. You decide what works best for you!Day by day, our Tech & Product Team of about 400 experts pursues the goal of creating the best possible customer shopping experience for our online marketplace. Through innovative technical developments, they not only create an outstanding shopping experience but also lay the foundation for an optimal selling experience for our sellers. Learn more about our division, areas, and cross-functional teams here!We are seeking a (Senior) n8n Business Automation Developer (all genders) for our growing Business Automation team where you can collaborate with cross-departmental teams to automate processes, leveraging AI and bleeding-edge tools to support our growing business. After your onboarding, you will have the opportunity to work directly within the business departments to combine technical and process-related skills into a role that helps to shape the future of E-Commerce.AufgabenYour tasks – this is what awaits you in detail• You automate complex business processes in a reliable and maintainable way, using tools like Claude and n8n• You create and optimize AI agents using modern LLMs and related tooling (prompting, retrieval, evaluation/guardrails, RAG)• You partner with business departments to analyze, redesign, and automate new and existing processes from discovery to rollout• You collaborate with our Center of Excellence for Automation to propose, prioritize, and lead initiatives that improve our automation and AI platforms• You work cross-functionally with technical experts, product managers, and business leaders to share best practices, document patterns, and enable self-serve automation across the companyProfilYour profile – this is what we expect from you• You are comfortable scripting in JavaScript for n8n Function nodes or have equivalent experience (foundational programming skills, Python experience, etc.)• You have experience with automation/orchestration tools like n8n, Zapier, Make, etc.• You are comfortable integrating SaaS tools and internal systems via APIs, webhooks, OAuth, and event-driven patterns• You are proficient with APIs and data manipulation: JSON, REST, SQL for joins/aggregations, and the occasional regex• Experience with prompt engineering and building AI Agents is a plus• You are a strong communicator who can explain trade-offs to both business and engineering stakeholders and create concise documentation/playbooks• You are fluent in English (C1) and enjoy working in an international environmentBenefitsWhat we offer• Create your own work-life balance: You have the flexibility to choose between working remotely (within Germany) or from one of our locations in Cologne, Darmstadt, Düsseldorf, or in Berlin!• Urban Sports Club and RSG Group Fitness Studios : Get top deals for fitness, swimming, yoga and more• Mental Well-Being: We support you on your well-being journey with special offerings such as Instahelp, the digital platform for online psychological counseling• Vacation & Sabbatical: Enjoy 30 days of vacation per year and the opportunity to take a sabbatical once you have been part of the team for a certain period!• Option for Pluxee restaurant vouchers : Buy Pluxee vouchers through us and benefit from tax-advantaged meal allowances!• ‘ Deutschlandticket’: We subsidize your train season ticket for more mobility• Employee Discount: You will receive a monthly coupon for Kaufland.de• Free choice of hardware: Mac or Lenovo, it's up to you• Boost your growth: Benefit from our online language learning programs, diverse in-house training, and our automated 360-degree feedback• This is who we are: Our dynamic culture combines flat hierarchies, a start-up mentality, an international team of over 65 nationalities, and the strength of the Schwarz Group to provide you an agile and secure working environment.• We are team players : From day one, you will connect not only with your team but also with others through our digital onboarding journey, the buddy program, and regular team and company events, all-hands meetings, powerful mornings, and much more!Check out our Principles & our blog for even more insights into our company culture!BewerbenDiversity at Kaufland e-commerceWe welcome applications from everyone, regardless of skin colour, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, disability, ethnic origin, religion and ideology. We are signatories to the Charta der Vielfalt (German Diversity Charter) – because we know that extraordinary things can only be achieved with diversity. Read more here! When applying, you can optionally include your pronouns in your resume.Why are you the perfect fit for this position?Don't bother with cover letters - we're interested in facts and figures! Feel free to share your Github profile with us in your application.As we have very international teams, we would highly appreciate it to receive your CV or profile link in English.We are looking forward to your application!Kaufland e-commerce Services GmbH & Co.
